The undo stack had no maild identity, so an Undo after a change between local and lodge moved or flagged other mail by ID; each maild now gets its own stack, and a worker still running keeps the stack it began with.

Activity entries waiting for activity.recent grew without limit, against ADR-0055's bound at every step; at most 256 now wait, and those without room are counted in one dropped entry.

A task write past the app's 60 s deadline advanced the task's write queue while maild could still run it, so the old write could land after the next one and undo it. A queued task write now has no deadline of the app's own: the next write waits for maild's answer, or for the connection's end, when maild cancels the request's context.

The task pane committed its Title and Notes and rebound them to the next task before the fields took the frame's input, so text typed or committed by an input method in the frame of a selection or source change was lost, or landed in the next task's field. A removed occurrence stayed selected while another series in its calendar had an occurrence at the same time, as the check matched only the recurrence ID and the calendar. It now matches the series: the selection's event ID, or an override whose event maild names with the series' UID.

An event window with changes refused Leave's close (MyGo's Window.Close asks CloseRequested), Leave still dropped it, and its Save then wrote the last maild's event and calendar IDs to the next maild; the close after Save and after Don't Save was refused the same way. A held delete let go after 10 s while the list still showed the stale row, and an error in the read after a successful delete let go of it too, so a repeated Delete erased the message from Trash. A hold now lasts until the list drops the row, shows it in other mailboxes, or a view opened since shows it; it lets go at once only when nothing was sent or maild still holds the message where the row shows it, and a delete that failed or was not read back stays held.

The palette kept its query, its results and a chosen item across a change of maild, so they acted on the new maild with the last one's message and mailbox IDs. leaveDaemon now closes the palette, and its replies and item runs are bound to the maild they came from.

Redirect parsed the To field before the field took the input of its frame, so an edit and a click in one frame sent the message to the old address. The addresses are now read after the field is built.

Undo.Move remembered nothing when its action failed part way, so a move whose first account's group went and second failed could not be undone. It now reads the messages after any action that ran and remembers the inverse of what changed.

correction: Keep exact instants for zero-delta drags, compare untitled new events with their initial draft, and retain WKST, last-weekday and UNTIL details when editing repeat rules.
evidence: #237: regression tests cover zero-delta repeated-hour and subminute instants, untitled location edits, a last Thursday in February, an explicit week start and timed UNTIL round trips.

correction: Accept and preserve required, optional, chair and none roles; editing another invitee must not rewrite existing roles or freeze the list.
evidence: #242 and #237: TestInviteeChairAndInformationRolesCanBeWritten creates and updates real calendar objects; native and web editor tests retain chair and information roles when the guest list changes.

correction: Non-message cache images in a saved draft need a draft-scoped content lookup; a message-part path parser cannot load them. Validate references and cache containment before signing.
evidence: TestLoadCachedDraftImageFromLodge renders a remote cached image; TestDraftImageNamesOnlyReferencedCachedImages checks the signed bytes and refused references, paths, files and size.

correction: Decode one remaining layer of entities and remove Cf characters and U+034F before applying preview quote, whitespace and length rules.
evidence: TestPreviewRemovesNewsletterPadding covers plain entity text, decoded padding and HTML escaped once and twice; TestPreviewCleansBeforeQuoteAndLengthRules covers formatting and truncation. Both fail with the cleanup reverted.

correction: Quote depth and list indentation need separate paragraph fields. Sharing Indent flattens nested quoted lists; paragraph IDs cannot carry inheritable formatting through a split.
evidence: TestListsInsideNestedQuotesKeepBothDepths checks exact HTML, splits, joins, undo and list formatting with the companion MyGo QuoteDepth change.

scope: pane name beside a long account (#282)
correction: A larger flex shrink factor still takes width from every shrinking item, so a text that must stay whole needs its own line or a fixed basis, and a test must not allow a fraction of loss.
evidence: TestEventPaneKeepsTheCalendarName, TestEventPaneKeepsAWideCalendarNameInsideThePane and TestTaskPaneKeepsTheListName check the name's exact width and the account's line under it. They fail on the old side-by-side row.

correction: A removal that writes only whitespace must keep the declaration-start state, or a later color-scheme declaration escapes the guard.
evidence: TestSanitizeCSSShowsALightPage: the cases color scheme after a removed at-rule, color scheme after an import, color scheme after cdo and cdo after cdc at the start fail without the fix.

correction: Do not search the message source for a URL scheme to decide whether to load its parts: the sanitizer decodes entities and CSS escapes, so the resolver must load them on the first cid: URL it is given.
evidence: TestRenderEmbedsEveryCIDForm: the entity colon, entity letter and css escape cases fail with the source precheck restored (the image is dropped); TestRenderMessageWithoutACIDURL keeps the lazy load honest.

correction: A narrower store read must keep the API error every caller already answers: only the new fault path (the blob store) may return a raw error, while a row read failure keeps its old code and text.
evidence: TestReadKeepsTheAnswerForADBFault: with a closed store and a blob store present, message.body must be unavailable with the old words; it fails with the raw error mapping.
